blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The International Criminal Court’s (ICC) Trial Chamber III held its final status conference on Monday, Nov. 2, ahead of the Nov. 30 trial of former President Rodrigo Duterte. At the status conference, the chamber addressed the following procedural matters: READ: Duterte required to physically attend trial – ICC To accommodate medical advice regarding Duterte’s physical stamina and facilitate client instructions, the chamber revised the evidentiary sitting schedule for the first block of hearings, which will run until Dec. 18, before the Christmas recess.
